title: FIG. 04 · Nested plates
summary: The stack is proved by the brand's own geometry: four heavy nested plates (the master mark's three pieces plus one outer step, same proportions) exploded along their diagonal on a FIG. plate, with a Plurel segmented control that moves the single red plate and widens its channels and keyed to four strips — where today's version shows radar-and-dashboard panels.

reference.site: Intercom — 'Powered by the Fin AI Engine'
reference.borrowed: Intercom's anatomy: a red-dot label over a large two-line headline at left with the lede pushed right and dropped to the headline's last line, then a full-width framed figure with a mono FIG caption in which one engineered object is exploded and its parts are called out by mono labels on long thin leaders.
reference.kelwin: The exploded engine becomes four nested right-angle plates built from the founder's master mark (three heavy pieces + one outer step at the same 45u bars / 15u channels; captioned as a figure, never as the logo), pulled apart along their own diagonal as flat paper plates with exactly one red plate; Intercom's two-sided callouts become four left-hung mono keys on straight 1px leaders that run to each plate's end; Intercom's brackets and rotated labels are dropped; a Plurel segmented control (tracked caps) drives the selection; the head carries the founder DNA (red-square caps label, two-voice wide headline, 48×2 red rule, the lede below it — not Intercom's lede-right split) with the source coda 'Services end. Architecture compounds.' as the bottom-right annotation ('■ Built to compound'); Metalab strips carry 'what it is / in practice'.

motion: entrance: the act opens on a hard cut from the paper evidence act; the label fades (300ms); the two statement lines rise out of masks (800ms --ease-out, light clause 320ms later); the 48×2 red rule draws; the lede and the annotation fade up 12px; the plate fades in and the three outer plates slide in from the top-right along the explode diagonal one at a time (700ms, 120ms stagger); the core lands last, in red (400ms) — the 'installed' beat; the four leaders then draw from the left (scaleX, 80ms stagger) as the callouts fade in; strips rise with a 90ms cascade.

state change: at 2.4s the segmented control advances Intelligence → Orchestration: red moves from the core to L3, the plates outside L3 slide further along the diagonal so its channels open on both sides, each leader lengthens or shortens to stay on its plate and the callouts ride with them, and the L3 callout and strip title brighten (900ms --ease-inout).
ambient: none — the figure holds still after its one state change.
interaction: the segmented control is live (click any layer: red, channels, leaders and callouts follow); hovering a strip raises its title from --fg-2 to --fg.
on the live site: the figure advances its state once when the plate is 50% visible; prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state (Orchestration selected) with no entrance.
notes: Statement edited to 'We don't deliver work. / We install systems.' (fits cols 1–10 at 96px); 'Kelwin' moves into the lede. Four layers: the source (RevenueOS.tsx) has three; the Data layer copy comes from capability-data.tsx (Data pipeline & enrichment / CRM architecture). Geometry follows the LOGO CORRECTION: master K1–K3 at true proportions, extended one nested step outward for the fourth layer. Coherence pass: the closing row (coda + both doors) was removed — the coda became the head's bottom-right annotation and the doors live in the hero, fit, FAQ and final CTA, so the act no longer adds a second red action beside its red L3 plate; the lede was tightened to two lines; no top hairline, because the act follows the paper evidence act (a hard surface cut). Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
